Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL1267250. Join molecule_dictionary to activities via molregno, join assays via assay_id, and join compound_structures via molregno as an INNER JOIN. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL1267250, standard_relation = '=', and non-null standard_value and standard_relation. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
